Terms

Last updated: November 2026

These terms cover tutoring from Ali Aljawabra, trading as Ali Tutors, a Bath-based private tutor. Questions about them: alitutoring@outlook.com or 07397 270583.

The service

One-to-one tutoring in GCSE, A-level and KS3 subjects, and Maths for 11+ and 13+ entrance exams, held online via Google Meet. Sessions are charged at the hourly rates on the pricing page.

Booking and payment

  • You can start with a free intro call. There's no obligation to continue after it.
  • Sessions are booked in blocks of five, paid upfront through Stripe before the sessions begin.
  • After paying, you book your session times through the online calendar, ideally the same day and time each week.

Rescheduling

Let me know as early as possible and we'll find another time within the same block.

Cancellations and refunds

  • Cancel before a block starts for a full refund.
  • Once a block is underway, any sessions not yet taken are refunded. Sessions already delivered are not.

Your rights

Nothing in these terms affects your legal rights as a consumer.

Your information

How your personal information is handled is explained in the privacy policy.
